description: Get address by name with all entries. Strengthens associated memory on access. Does NOT resolve vault references - use resolve_with_secrets for that.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Full address record with keys: address (object with id, name, type, description, tags), entries (list of entry records with id, field_type, description, value)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieves an address by its registered name with all associated entries, strengthening memory association on access
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFoundError: no address registered with this name. DatabaseError: address book storage unavailable.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For not found: suggest using 'search' to find similar addresses or 'register' to create a new one. For database errors: suggest retrying or checking service status.
